5:   # Quick Claw, Custap Berry's "X let it move first!" message.
6:   def pbAttackPhasePriorityChangeMessages
7:     pbPriority.each do |b|
8:       if b.effects[PBEffects::PriorityAbility] && b.abilityActive?
9:         Battle::AbilityEffects.triggerPriorityBracketUse(b.ability, b, self)
10:       elsif b.effects[PBEffects::PriorityItem] && b.itemActive?
11:         Battle::ItemEffects.triggerPriorityBracketUse(b.item, b, self)
12:       end
13:     end
14:   end

16:   def pbAttackPhaseCall
17:     pbPriority.each do |b|
18:       next unless @choices[b.index][0] == :Call && !b.fainted?
19:       b.lastMoveFailed = false   # Counts as a successful move for Stomping Tantrum
20:       pbCall(b.index)
21:     end
22:   end

24:   def pbPursuit(idxSwitcher)
25:     @switching = true
26:     pbPriority.each do |b|
27:       next if b.fainted? || !b.opposes?(idxSwitcher)   # Shouldn't hit an ally
28:       next if b.movedThisRound? || !pbChoseMoveFunctionCode?(b.index, "PursueSwitchingFoe")
29:       # Check whether Pursuit can be used
30:       next unless pbMoveCanTarget?(b.index, idxSwitcher, @choices[b.index][2].pbTarget(b))
31:       next unless pbCanChooseMove?(b.index, @choices[b.index][1], false)
32:       next if b.status == :SLEEP || b.status == :FROZEN
33:       next if b.effects[PBEffects::SkyDrop] >= 0
34:       next if b.hasActiveAbility?(:TRUANT) && b.effects[PBEffects::Truant]
35:       # Mega Evolve
36:       if !b.wild?
37:         owner = pbGetOwnerIndexFromBattlerIndex(b.index)
38:         pbMegaEvolve(b.index) if @megaEvolution[b.idxOwnSide][owner] == b.index
39:       end
40:       # Use Pursuit
41:       @choices[b.index][3] = idxSwitcher   # Change Pursuit's target
42:       b.pbProcessTurn(@choices[b.index], false)
43:       break if @decision > 0 || @battlers[idxSwitcher].fainted?
44:     end
45:     @switching = false
46:   end

48:   def pbAttackPhaseSwitch
49:     pbPriority.each do |b|
50:       next unless @choices[b.index][0] == :SwitchOut && !b.fainted?
51:       idxNewPkmn = @choices[b.index][1]   # Party index of Pokémon to switch to
52:       b.lastMoveFailed = false   # Counts as a successful move for Stomping Tantrum
53:       @lastMoveUser = b.index
54:       # Switching message
55:       pbMessageOnRecall(b)
56:       # Pursuit interrupts switching
57:       pbPursuit(b.index)
58:       return if @decision > 0
59:       # Switch Pokémon
60:       allBattlers.each do |b2|
61:         b2.droppedBelowHalfHP = false
62:         b2.statsDropped = false
63:       end
64:       pbRecallAndReplace(b.index, idxNewPkmn)
65:       pbOnBattlerEnteringBattle(b.index, true)
66:     end
67:   end

69:   def pbAttackPhaseItems
70:     pbPriority.each do |b|
71:       next unless @choices[b.index][0] == :UseItem && !b.fainted?
72:       b.lastMoveFailed = false   # Counts as a successful move for Stomping Tantrum
73:       item = @choices[b.index][1]
74:       next if !item
75:       case GameData::Item.get(item).battle_use
76:       when 1, 2   # Use on Pokémon/Pokémon's move
77:         pbUseItemOnPokemon(item, @choices[b.index][2], b) if @choices[b.index][2] >= 0
78:       when 3      # Use on battler
79:         pbUseItemOnBattler(item, @choices[b.index][2], b)
80:       when 4      # Use Poké Ball
81:         pbUsePokeBallInBattle(item, @choices[b.index][2], b)
82:       when 5      # Use directly
83:         pbUseItemInBattle(item, @choices[b.index][2], b)
84:       else
85:         next
86:       end
87:       return if @decision > 0
88:     end
89:     pbCalculatePriority if Settings::RECALCULATE_TURN_ORDER_AFTER_SPEED_CHANGES
90:   end

92:   def pbAttackPhaseMegaEvolution
93:     pbPriority.each do |b|
94:       next if b.wild?
95:       next unless @choices[b.index][0] == :UseMove && !b.fainted?
96:       owner = pbGetOwnerIndexFromBattlerIndex(b.index)
97:       next if @megaEvolution[b.idxOwnSide][owner] != b.index
98:       pbMegaEvolve(b.index)
99:     end
100:   end

102:   def pbAttackPhaseMoves
103:     # Show charging messages (Focus Punch)
104:     pbPriority.each do |b|
105:       next unless @choices[b.index][0] == :UseMove && !b.fainted?
106:       next if b.movedThisRound?
107:       @choices[b.index][2].pbDisplayChargeMessage(b)
108:     end
109:     # Main move processing loop
110:     loop do
111:       priority = pbPriority
112:       # Forced to go next
113:       advance = false
114:       priority.each do |b|
115:         next unless b.effects[PBEffects::MoveNext] && !b.fainted?
116:         next unless @choices[b.index][0] == :UseMove || @choices[b.index][0] == :Shift
117:         next if b.movedThisRound?
118:         advance = b.pbProcessTurn(@choices[b.index])
119:         break if advance
120:       end
121:       return if @decision > 0
122:       next if advance
123:       # Regular priority order
124:       priority.each do |b|
125:         next if b.effects[PBEffects::Quash] > 0 || b.fainted?
126:         next unless @choices[b.index][0] == :UseMove || @choices[b.index][0] == :Shift
127:         next if b.movedThisRound?
128:         advance = b.pbProcessTurn(@choices[b.index])
129:         break if advance
130:       end
131:       return if @decision > 0
132:       next if advance
133:       # Quashed
134:       if Settings::MECHANICS_GENERATION >= 8
135:         priority.each do |b|
136:           next unless b.effects[PBEffects::Quash] > 0 && !b.fainted?
137:           next unless @choices[b.index][0] == :UseMove || @choices[b.index][0] == :Shift
138:           next if b.movedThisRound?
139:           advance = b.pbProcessTurn(@choices[b.index])
140:           break if advance
141:         end
142:       else
143:         quashLevel = 0
144:         loop do
145:           quashLevel += 1
146:           moreQuash = false
147:           priority.each do |b|
148:             moreQuash = true if b.effects[PBEffects::Quash] > quashLevel
149:             next unless b.effects[PBEffects::Quash] == quashLevel && !b.fainted?
150:             next unless @choices[b.index][0] == :UseMove || @choices[b.index][0] == :Shift
151:             next if b.movedThisRound?
152:             advance = b.pbProcessTurn(@choices[b.index])
153:             break
154:           end
155:           break if advance || !moreQuash
156:         end
157:       end
158:       return if @decision > 0
159:       next if advance
160:       # Check for all done
161:       priority.each do |b|
162:         next if b.fainted?
163:         next if b.movedThisRound? || ![:UseMove, :Shift].include?(@choices[b.index][0])
164:         advance = true
165:         break
166:       end
167:       next if advance
168:       # All Pokémon have moved; end the loop
169:       break
170:     end
171:   end

176:   def pbAttackPhase
177:     @scene.pbBeginAttackPhase
178:     # Reset certain effects
179:     @battlers.each_with_index do |b, i|
180:       next if !b
181:       b.turnCount += 1 if !b.fainted?
182:       @successStates[i].clear
183:       if @choices[i][0] != :UseMove && @choices[i][0] != :Shift && @choices[i][0] != :SwitchOut
184:         b.effects[PBEffects::DestinyBond] = false
185:         b.effects[PBEffects::Grudge]      = false
186:       end
187:       b.effects[PBEffects::Rage] = false if !pbChoseMoveFunctionCode?(i, "StartRaiseUserAtk1WhenDamaged")
188:     end
189:     # Calculate move order for this round
190:     pbCalculatePriority(true)
191:     PBDebug.log("")
192:     # Perform actions
193:     pbAttackPhasePriorityChangeMessages
194:     pbAttackPhaseCall
195:     pbAttackPhaseSwitch
196:     return if @decision > 0
197:     pbAttackPhaseItems
198:     return if @decision > 0
199:     pbAttackPhaseMegaEvolution
200:     pbAttackPhaseMoves
201:   end
